description: Unit tests for the RubiksCube engine, verifying move validation, cube state, undo/redo functionality, scramble, and move inverse calculations.

classes.name: RubiksCube
classes.description: Represents a Rubik's Cube with methods for move validation, state checking, and manipulation.

methods.name: getInverseMove
methods.description: Returns the inverse move notation for a given move.

methods.name: makeMove
methods.description: Executes a move on the cube, returning an object indicating if the move was valid.

methods.name: undo
methods.description: Reverts the last move made on the cube.

methods.name: scramble
methods.description: Randomly applies a specified number of moves to scramble the cube.

methods.name: isSolved
methods.description: Checks whether the cube is in a solved state.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Returns the current state of the cube.

methods.name: auditState
methods.description: Provides an audit of the cube's face colors.
